propositions: When a bug is closed with --class duplicate but has no recorded duplicates link, the gate falls through to LLM verification which fails with non-actionable remediation text that never mentions the actual required action: recording the duplicates link.
The close_precheck gate must hard-fail before LLM verification when closing a duplicate without a live replacement link, raising CommandError with the exact rebar link command needed.
The gate must accept a duplicates link targeting a closed canonical ticket, requiring link existence but not target openness.
A duplicates link naming an archived or unresolvable target must produce a distinct error message from the no-link case, clarifying which named target is dead.
The hard-fail scope must apply only to duplicate class, not to not_a_bug or escalated classes, which keep the original fallthrough behavior.
